Hi Lena —

Thanks again for moving quickly on the POC. We want to set up a 90-minute hands-on session to kickoff the POC and run a short benchmark so we can validate throughput/latency assumptions against your sample workload. Proposed agenda (high level):

- Intros + goals (10 min)
- Prompt review & routing rules (20 min)
- Hands-on load test: test harness review, run smoke, then sustained run (45 min)
- Next steps & ownerships (15 min)

Dates we have available:
- Mon, Oct 20 — 9:00–10:30 PT or 11:00–12:30 PT
- Wed, Oct 22 — 10:00–11:30 PT

Can you confirm which slot works best and who from your side should join (model/infrastructure/POC owner)? I attached a one-page POC scope and a sample load CSV so the load test is representative.

Attachments: POC-scope.pdf (1p), pre-sample-load.csv (10KB)

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Marissa

Hi Lena + Mike —

8:30 PT is a bit early for a couple of folks on our side (we have team in EU). Would 9:00 PT on Oct 20 work instead? If not, we can move to the Oct 22 window (10:00 PT) that I also proposed.

Per your ask, attaching the initial test harness config and a short runbook link. The harness uses our k6 wrapper and a small model shim; its configured to run a 5-minute smoke followed by configurable sustained run parameters. Recommended initial targets (for discussion):

- Sustained throughput: 500 req/s
- Ramp-up: 60s
- Run duration: 10 min (initial), extend to 30 min if stable
- Latency target: 95th <= 350ms at 2k sequence length (approx sample workload)

Attachments: loadtest-harness-config.yml
Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cPOC-shared

If Oct 20 9:00 PT is OK Ill send the calendar invite and prep a short pre-POC checklist for your infra team.

Thanks,
Marissa

All —

Oct 22, 10:00 PT works for our infra + runtime team. A few notes to make the session efficient:

- Please confirm the staging model artifact location and whether Orbit will provide a container image or we'll use our curated model from the Redwood catalog.
- We should run a 5-min smoke (single client) then a sustained ramp to 500 req/s. If we see stability we can increase to 800 req/s for an additional 10 minutes.
- Telemetry: please enable token-level tracing and include a short sample of prompts to exercise routing logic. We'll capture p95/p99 and breakdown by prompt class.
- Fall-back plan: if staging infra can't reach our hosted endpoints, we'll fallback to an isolated Dedicated node (we can spin one up for the window).

I've attached a throughput-performance matrix that maps request sizes to expected token throughput per GPU -- helps pick the right test parameters.

Attachments: throughput-performance-matrix.xlsx

I will create a short run script and post the link tomorrow; Marissa can send the calendar invite once we confirm.

- Aditya
